reason: I'd sign up for the free 5 weeks, but honestly I'll do it a couple of times then drift. I'm a class person, I turn up because the other mums are there, not because a video is waiting on my phone. 45 minutes a day at home with two kids just isn't happening.
objection: No one is checking in on me or expecting me, so I won't stick with it, and by the time the free 5 weeks are done I won't have finished it, let alone want to pay for more.
would_change_my_mind: A group element, like a weekly live session or a small mums' group doing the 8 weeks together with check-ins, and shorter 20-minute sessions.
